description: P472-03 application-wide tenant-isolation findings observed by the sweep. Each entry is an OPEN finding. tests/test_p472_03_application_wide_isolation.py fails if a route appears that is not listed here, and if a listed route stops reproducing without being removed.

classes.AW-01: Tenant header trusted with no membership check
classes.AW-02: Membership checked on one tenant header, data scoped by another
classes.AW-03: Handler re-reads the tenant from a header the auth layer did not verify
classes.AW-04: Tenant taken from a query, path or body parameter
classes.AW-05: Header trusted when the user has no single verified tenant
classes.AW-06M: Verified members without a tenant header are pooled in ``default-tenant``
classes.AW-06N: Users with no membership are pooled in ``default-tenant``
classes.AW-09: Unauthenticated request reads or writes tenant tables
classes.AW-UNAUTH: Tenant-scoped SQL executed for an unauthenticated or invalid-token caller
